newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Fin Minister to brief President Kim on Kia.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Fin Minister to brief President Kim on Kia.

text.p: South Korean Finance Minister Kang Kyong-shik will brief President Kim Young-sam on the troubles at the Kia Group at 0600 GMT, ministry officials said on Wednesday.
They said Kang would explain the causes of Kia's problems and the actions taken so far to resolve the situation.
Ministry officials said the ministry had not decided whether to support granting soft loans through the Bank of Korea to the Korea First Bank, Kia's main creditor.
"Korea First Bank should first restructure itself before the central bank makes any loans," a ministry official said.
He said the decision would be made prudently because of its impact on price stability and the danger that it would be regarded as preferential treatment for Korea First Bank.
The monetary board, chaired by the finance minister, is scheduled to act on the bank's request on Thursday.
